payload.posture: Read 1 Peter 1:10–12 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states prophets search their own witness, learn that they serve later hearers, and the preached good news is described as announced by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
